justification: New page with DB query (regulatory_definitions), client-side interactive component, JSON-LD schemas, and updates to sitemap/footer/llms.txt. 5 files changed.

pre_impl.existing_data: Reads from regulatory_definitions table (465+ rows). Table has been stable since Jan 2026. No writes.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If table is empty or missing, fetchDefinitions() catches error and returns empty array — page renders with 0 definitions, no crash.

functions.name: fetchDefinitions
functions.input: no parameters — fetches all definitions ordered by term_normalized
functions.output: DefinitionRow[] — array of definition objects with term, text, source, tags
functions.if_none: returns empty array on error — page renders empty state with 'No definitions match' message

functions.name: GlossaryClient
functions.output: interactive glossary UI with search, filters, and expandable definitions
functions.if_none: empty definitions array shows 'No definitions match' with clear filters button

values.nullable: no — always returns array (empty on error)
values.if_missing: page shows 0 definitions, search/filters still render
domain tags section not rendered, no tool CTA shown

queries.purpose: Fetch all regulatory definitions for glossary page
queries.where_clause: none — fetches all rows ORDER BY term_normalized ASC
queries.if_zero: page renders empty state, no crash
queries.if_wrong: no WHERE clause means no wrong-scope risk — reads entire table

break_it.scenario: Database connection fails during ISR revalidation
break_it.what_happens: fetchDefinitions catches error, returns empty array. Page shows 0 definitions with working search/filter UI.
break_it.how: glossary/page.tsx:44 — try/catch wraps entire query, logs error, returns []
break_it.repro: Set DATABASE_URL to invalid value, visit /glossary

break_it.scenario: Definition with null term (first character) breaks alphabet nav
break_it.what_happens: Could cause undefined in letter set
break_it.how: glossary/page.tsx:70 — .filter(Boolean) removes undefined/null values from letters set
break_it.repro: Insert row with empty term, visit /glossary

break_it.scenario: XSS via definition_text containing HTML/script tags
break_it.what_happens: React auto-escapes text content in JSX — no XSS possible. JSON-LD uses JSON.stringify which also escapes.
break_it.how: React JSX text rendering + JSON.stringify both auto-escape HTML entities
break_it.repro: Insert definition with <script> tag, view page source

post_merge.manual_verify: Visit /glossary — confirm definitions load, search works, filters work, expand a definition to see source citation and tool CTA
